items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: It is to become an individual, like a Fats Waller, like a Louis Armstrong...

ctx.x: I'll send for Slam any day, any week.

You just send for Milt Hinton. As a keynote, people do not know what it means to become a star. It is to become an individual, like a Fats Waller, like a Louis Armstrong, like a Dizzy Gillespie, like a Charlie Parker, like an Art Tatum, or like an Erroll Garner. It takes a long time to become an individual. The only way we get this, Milt, you know how it is - it's the way we live. You know it's very difficult. We would love to play with each other all the time, but circumstances do not warrant the fact that we…
